findings.evidence: Carried R5 PLAUSIBLE, now also in the new streaming path. pre/post chain_identity and graph_identity hash Processor::identity() AFTER the stream ran. RampedGain identity contains `current`, which becomes `target` after the first block, so a 0->1 ramp bounce and a flat 1.0 bounce share graph_identity but differ in digest. The whole-clip oracle has the same order, so the equality test cannot catch it.
findings.remediation: Capture pre/post identity right after StageRunner::new/proc.reset(), before the first block

findings.evidence: Carried R2/R3 PLAUSIBLE items, unchanged in this scope. InputBlock::validate does not call ticks_per_sample, so run_block admits non-divisor rates. A f32::MAX gain can publish inf. Limiter and EQ reset on discard instead of restoring a commit snapshot.
findings.remediation: ticks_per_sample in validate; refuse non-finite output; snapshot/restore via commit

verified_fixes: Bit-identity claim HOLDS by construction and by test. rubato 5.0.1 process_all_into_buffer (lib.rs:323-398, local registry) processes full chunks while frames_left > chunk, then the last chunk with partial_len = Some(frames_left), then pumps Some(0). A full chunk sent with Some(chunk) is identical to None, because asynchro.rs:651-655 reads min(partial, needed_input_size) and zero-fills only below needed_input_size. stream_resample.rs:238-310 makes the same call sequence: pad zeros first, process a chunk as soon as it fills, the partial tail at finish, then Some(0) pumps. It skips trim+drop (to_skip) and delivers exactly `requested`, so the delivered frames match the whole-clip path, which drops `drop` after rubato's own trim.

Test is independent, not echoed: tests/streaming_src.rs:139-171 compares to_bits of streaming against Engine::resample (whole clip). It covers 5 rate pairs x 53 lengths, including 1005 (1005+19 pad = 1024 = chunk at 44.1k->48k) and 1023/1024/1025, which hit the padded % chunk == 0 path. Pushes are 1/7/255/1000 frames, plus a 4 s clip with 4096/333 pushes. :214-241 shows the streaming bounce receipt equals the whole-clip oracle field by field (working_set_bytes excepted) with limiter latency 341 -> converter -> EQ at blocks 256 and 77.

Exact counts: requested_frames (resample.rs:206-214) is u128 div_ceil. Hand check: 13,230,000 x 48000/44100 = 14,400,000 exactly; 1000@44.1k->48k = ceil(1088.44) = 1089; 1000@48k->44.1k = ceil(918.75) = 919. The test asserts these against (frames*out).div_ceil(in) computed in the test. trimmed_tail = expected_raw - requested - drop is non-negative because begin_stream refuses expected_raw < requested + drop (stream_resample.rs:102-107).

Working-set claim is honest and scoped. working_set_bytes = 2 StageRunner staging blocks + stream_in + stream_out (src_bounce.rs:501, stage.rs:72,85, stream_resample.rs:82-84). It explicitly excludes rubato's internal history (src_bounce.rs:125-129). Mono, 256-block, chunk 1024: 2x1024 + 4096 + 4496 = 10,640 B. tests/streaming_src.rs:286-303 compares the 300 s run with a 2 s run of the same graph: equal working_set_bytes, equal allocation-call count, peak within 4 KiB. The ignored real-rate test carries an #[ignore] reason (V4-03).
Carried R5 cap_duplicate (layout.rs tick math) FIXED in 2fe5f36: ticks_per_sample and sample_to_ticks delegate to accord Timescale (layout.rs:69-89).

Arithmetic re-read: stage.rs:151 and src_bounce.rs:551 additions are bounded by plan() checks (input_start+frames+latency and output_start+requested+latency checked at src_bounce.rs:276-288). begin_stream checked_add on pad and needed. No untrusted-byte decoding in this crate (V4-01 n/a).
lanes.recommendation_note: The streaming SRC is bit-identical by construction (same rubato call sequence; partial Some(chunk) == None verified in rubato source) and by an independent to_bits oracle test. Counts are exact u128 and the working-set claim is scoped and measured. Open items are carried PLAUSIBLEs.

findings.evidence: try_push_block counts one overrun and one discontinuity when it refuses a Full offer, though the caller keeps the block and nothing is dropped. Counters documents discontinuities as 'points where the delivered stream is not contiguous with the offered stream'. foundation_contract proves the delivered stream IS contiguous (consumed == produced bit for bit, :131) while asserting discontinuities == 2 (:136). Under healthy backpressure the native smoke reported overruns=30 on a gap-free stream. A consumer cannot tell real gaps from retried offers. The brief's test 1 mandates this count, so the defect is shared with the brief.
findings.remediation: Count Full as a separate refused_offers counter; keep overrun/discontinuity for real drops; amend brief test 1

findings.evidence: Capability 5 (CpalProvider, cpal_backend.rs) compiles only with feature cpal-backend, and round-features.toml declares no score-device feature set. The round never builds, clippy-checks or doc-tests cpal_backend.rs. Its only compile evidence is the builder's own run. The registry pin exists (Cargo.toml metadata registry.hsk-studio-score-device direct cpal 0.18.2).
findings.remediation: Add hsk-studio-score-device = [["cpal-backend"]] to round-features (build/clippy; native test stays #[ignore])

findings.evidence: Cancel is checked once in prepare. open_output then blocks on ready_rx.recv_timeout(OPEN_WAIT = 15 s) with no cancel poll. On timeout, dropping CpalBackend joins the owner thread, which can block further while build_output_stream hangs (limitation disclosed in the lane notes).
findings.remediation: Wait for readiness in short slices polling cancel; on cancel request_stop and return Canceled

findings.evidence: Admission::acquire says it takes 'ring_bytes of ring budget, or refuses with AdmissionDenied', but it only refuses on max_open_streams. bytes_in_flight is counted and never bounded. The total is bounded only implicitly (max_open_streams x max_ring_bytes, plus loopback).
findings.remediation: Add Limits.max_bytes_in_flight checked in acquire, or reword the doc to the implicit bound

verified_fixes: Realtime callback no-alloc/no-lock HOLDS. render_callback/capture_callback (callback.rs:12-33) call only Consumer::pop_into / Producer::push_frames and relaxed counter fetch_adds (ring.rs, counters.rs). They have no Mutex, no allocation and no I/O. tests/callback_alloc.rs:62-130 runs 10,000 iterations under a per-thread counting allocator, and its self-check (:82-89) proves the allocator is not blind. The source scan bans locks, push, format and sleep in callback/ring/counters. The cpal data callback is only render_callback (cpal_backend.rs:120-122); the error callback only swaps an AtomicBool and bumps a counter (:123-127).

Ring correctness HOLDS. Cursors run in [0, 2*capacity) and index = cursor % capacity. occupied() handles the wrap (ring.rs:30-36); the producer's tail+len and the consumer's head+take are reduced mod wrap and cannot overflow (len <= capacity). config.rs:73-75 checks capacity*2. The producer writes data Relaxed and then publishes tail with Release; the consumer Acquire-loads tail. The consumer frees space with a Release store on head; the producer Acquire-loads head. Occupancy is always a whole number of frames (block_samples or take*channels). foundation_contract.rs:85-136 checks wrap order bit for bit.

Underrun output is safe silence: render_callback zero-fills out[copied..] and counts underrun_frames (callback.rs:12-25). Device loss is checked before WrongLength/Full and counts nothing (ring.rs:129-131). CloseReport::reconciles is submitted == consumed + residual (provider.rs:138-140), and residual is re-read after the backend quiesced (provider.rs:210,267).

cpal backend gating HOLDS. cpal is optional (Cargo.toml:9,15), mod and re-exports sit behind cfg(feature=cpal-backend) (lib.rs:19-20,33-34), forbid(unsafe_code) covers the whole crate in both builds, the example --cpal returns feature_cpal_backend_off without the feature, and tests/native_cpal.rs is cfg-gated, #[ignore]d and panics NOT_PROVEN unless STUDIO_NATIVE_AUDIO=1 (V4-03). Open order is cancel > grant > config > permit, and the permit is released by the owner thread only after the stream is paused and dropped (cpal_backend.rs:151-176).
No D18 supervision code: the crate spawns only its own clock/owner threads (no Command); no 4th supervisor copy.
lanes.recommendation_note: Callback, ring and gating claims hold. The Full->overrun+discontinuity count is a real semantic defect, but the brief's test 1 mandates it; route it as a brief amendment (lead decision) rather than a builder FAIL. Add cpal-backend to the round feature matrix so capability 5 is at least compiled by the validator.

findings.file_line: crates/hsk-studio-score-plugin/src/clap_backend.rs:126-128,140-159 (verify_file then load_entry), :68 (PluginEntry::load by path); src/backend.rs:70-87; src/lib.rs:56 (DESCRIPTOR authorization.content_check)
findings.evidence: The authorization rule is that foreign code runs only when its SHA-256 equals the hash the grant names. The worker hashes the file through one open (backend.rs:77-81 fs::read), then the dynamic loader opens the same PATH again (clap_backend.rs:68). Whoever can write the plugin path between the two opens gets unapproved code run in a worker with the user's full privileges (env_clear only, no sandbox). This is disclosed at clap_backend.rs:20-21 and in the lane's known_limits, but the DESCRIPTOR still says 'the worker checks again before use' without naming the window.
findings.remediation: Load from a private staging copy hashed in place (or hash the opened handle); disclose the window in DESCRIPTOR now

findings.file_line: crates/hsk-studio-score-plugin/src/supervisor.rs:394,453,467 (Instant + Duration); src/host.rs:287-297 (only is_zero checked), :497,:629-641 (shutdown_grace passed as deadline/patience)
findings.evidence: Per-call deadlines are bounded by MAX_DEADLINE (60 s, host.rs:220-226), but HostLimits.spawn_timeout and shutdown_grace are only checked non-zero. supervisor.rs computes Instant::now() + spawn_timeout and Instant::now() + patience, and std's Instant + Duration panics on overflow. With spawn_timeout = Duration::MAX the first spawn panics in the host. That contradicts the lane note 'deadlines are bounded by MAX_DEADLINE (60 s) before they reach it'. supervisor.rs is not under deny(arithmetic_side_effects) (the lane's known_limits acknowledge this).
findings.remediation: Bound spawn_timeout/shutdown_grace (<= MAX_DEADLINE) in IsolatedHost::new or use Instant::checked_add

findings.evidence: Third instance of the R5 PLAUSIBLE seen in motion-js and reel-native. With no explicit program, score-plugin-worker[.exe] is also accepted from the PARENT of the running executable's directory. A planted binary there runs as the worker, and HELLO checks only a self-reported identity and ABI.
findings.remediation: Search only the executable directory, or require HostOptions.program outside tests

findings.evidence: Host and worker each hash the plugin file with std::fs::read into one buffer of up to 512 MiB by default. This allocation is not charged to the admission budget (max_in_flight_bytes counts only block and state bytes), and it repeats on every probe and activate.
findings.remediation: Hash with a streaming SHA-256 over a fixed buffer (O(1) memory) in both host and worker

findings.evidence: The host adopts state versions reported by the worker, which runs foreign code: E_STALE detail, ParamSet.version and State.version are not checked to be monotonic or equal to the host's own. A misbehaving plugin process can rewind state_version so process_expecting accepts a block prepared under an older state. The stale-state guard therefore relies on worker honesty.
findings.remediation: Host owns the version counter; accept only version == host_version + 1 from ParamSet and equality elsewhere

verified_fixes: Process isolation HOLDS. The host crate never loads foreign code. verify_content is a bounded fs::read plus SHA-256 (host.rs:246-263), and only the worker binary contains clap_backend (lib.rs:24-26 cfg(feature=clap)). Every call goes through Supervisor sessions (env_clear, null stderr, piped stdio, CREATE_NO_WINDOW: supervisor.rs:348-355). Every error path after spawn drops the Session, which kills and reaps (:534-539), and the Permit is the last field so it is released after the reap (:228-229).

D18 / no 4th copy: Command::new, creation_flags, env_clear, try_wait, kill and Stdio in score-plugin product code occur only in src/supervisor.rs. A grep over src/ and examples/ of score-plugin, score-device, score, press and web at bd8533f finds no other site, matching .config/duplicate-fingerprints.toml D18 allowed (exact file supervisor.rs). The HELLO wait now polls cancel in WAIT_SLICE steps (supervisor.rs:394-400 via wait :410-426), which removes the uncancellable-HELLO PLAUSIBLE of the two older copies.

test-faults gating HOLDS (V4-04). mod faults and FAULT_EXIT_CODE sit behind cfg(feature=test-faults) (lib.rs:28-29,40-41), as do HostOptions.test_args and args.extend (host.rs:96-97,314-315) and the worker --fault arm (worker.rs:92-93). The default worker uses the no-op no_faults stub (worker.rs:29-47), so --fault is an unknown flag (exit 2). The example returns fault_flags_need_feature_test_faults without the feature. Cargo.toml has no dev-dependency that enables test-faults. round-features.toml runs [test-faults] and [clap, test-faults] units.

CLAP unsafe surface: forbid(unsafe_code) without clap and deny with it (lib.rs:20-21). Only clap_backend has #[allow(unsafe_code)] (:25-26), and it contains one unsafe block, PluginEntry::load, with a SAFETY comment (clap_backend.rs:64-68). Dropping the local `entry` after configure is sound: clack-host 0.2.0 PluginInstance stores a clone of the PluginEntry ('Keep the DLL/.SO alive', registry clack-host-0.2.0/src/plugin/instance.rs:20,48).

Wire V4-01/02: deny(arithmetic_side_effects) on wire/host/backend/worker/clap_backend. read_frame refuses length > cap before reading (wire.rs:138-149) and reads incrementally through take(). samples() bounds frames and channels before checked_mul (:243-255). decode_* requires done() (no trailing bytes). Tests dims_u32_max (:853) and aggregate_over_budget (:907) exist. The host checks Processed replies for version, frames, channels, sample count, completeness and latency before copying (host.rs:760-769), and non-finite output is refused with silence written (:770-773).
lanes.recommendation_note: Isolation, single-module supervision (no 4th copy), test-faults gating and the CLAP unsafe surface are as claimed. Two CONFIRMED items need cheap fixes: bound HostLimits durations, and disclose or close the hash-then-load window (disclosed in code, not in DESCRIPTOR). FAIL only if the lead treats the disclosed TOCTOU as blocking for the CLAP scope.

TextRedactedOutput::is_proven = report.complete && proof.is_clean() (text_fields.rs:248-250). All four claim sites route through fully_decoded. tests/pdf_delivery.rs:1170-1201 builds a control document that is proven, then a catalog-reachable /JBIG2Decode stream holding zlib bytes of the needle. An independent inflate shows the needle survives, and the test asserts streams_not_decodable == [(20, JBIG2Decode)] and !is_clean, !region_cleared, !is_proven.

The raster exception does not undo the R5 test: raster_tail requires /Subtype /Image (raster.rs:50-55), so the R5 test's non-image stream still blocks. Inline images with Crypt/unknown or misplaced raster filters are Blocking (raster.rs:67-88).

Matching keys are renamed, all values are kept, and the result is sorted by raw bytes (PDF lexical order) and written as one root leaf without /Limits (:1139-1145). edit_at follows indirect /Names and tree roots (:1021-1052), and the old Kids become unreachable and are dropped by the reachable-only writer. Minor: dedup_by (:1141) silently drops a duplicated key of a malformed tree.

Per-class completeness gaps are not soundness gaps: every string/name object, decoded non-content stream and raw byte outside decoded spans is scanned (sanitized_save.rs:330-342, 407-411, 442-446). findings.file_line: crates/hsk-studio-web/src/charref.rs:94-109 (named ref without ';' left verbatim), :11-12 (claim); src/cssurl.rs:143-171, 244-247; src/assets.rs:384-391, 426
findings.evidence:
Per the WHATWG named character reference state, a browser decodes the legacy semicolon-less names (", ", &, <, >, ...) inside an attribute value unless the next character is '=' or alphanumeric. charref.rs keeps them verbatim and claims they 'never produce URL-structural characters', but " yields '"', the CSS string delimiter. Payload:

. The browser reads font-family:"a" ;background-image:url(https://evil.example/b.png) and fetches the URL. css_references sees an unterminated string running to EOF, so the external URL is neither denied nor reported. Same failure class as R5 (raw text classified before browser decoding); no test covers semicolon-less named references.
findings.remediation: Decode the legacy no-semicolon names per the attribute rule (or deny values holding one); add an &quot test

findings.file_line: crates/hsk-studio-web/src/dom.rs:496-525 (svg/math subtree parsed as foreign, no HTML integration points); src/assets.rs:446-452 (Text style children charref-decoded)
findings.evidence: Inside an HTML integration point (svg foreignObject/desc/title, MathML mi/mo/mn/ms/mtext, annotation-xml) a browser parses <style> as HTML RAWTEXT, where character references are NOT decoded. The parser has no integration points: it parses that <style> as foreign content with Text children, and style_children charref-decodes them. Payload: <svg><foreignObject><style>a{x:"}b{background:url(https://evil.example/x.png)}</style>... (one line). The code decodes " to '"', opening a phantom string to EOF that hides the url(). The browser tokenizes " as plain characters and fetches the URL.
findings.remediation: Model integration points (style under them is raw text, no charref decode), or refuse style text whose two readings disagree

findings.evidence: SVG SMIL <set>/<animate> with attributeName=href|xlink:href carry URLs in to/from/values/by (for example <image href=ok.png><set attributeName=href to=https://evil.example/a.png/></image>). These attributes are not scanned, and DESCRIPTOR not_scanned does not list them, so the report again under-states its scope (R5 FAIL #2 class). Browser fetch on animated href is per SVG animatable-href semantics, not re-verified online in this review.
findings.remediation: Scan to/from/values/by of set/animate whose attributeName is href/xlink:href/src, or list them in not_scanned

verified_fixes: R5 FAIL css-escape-bypasses-url-classification FIXED for CSS escapes. cssurl.rs implements CSS Syntax 3 tokenization: escapes are decoded first (4.3.7, :100-123; hex 1-6 digits + one whitespace, 0/surrogate/>10FFFF -> U+FFFD); ident sequences are decoded (:125-141), so u\72l(, \75rl( and URL( are url functions (:271-291); url-token handles whitespace and bad-url (:185-233); strings handle escaped newline continuation and bad-string on a raw newline (:143-171); comments, strings, numbers with units (1url( is a dimension) and hash names are skipped (:243-270). classify maps '\' to '/' only on the decoded value (assets.rs:149-182). tests/source_dom_patch.rs:641-676 and :679-714 cover escape, decoy (comment, string, url/**/(, url (, xurl(, 1url() and case/whitespace: the V4-08 three classes.

R5 FAIL base-href-and-url-attributes-unscanned FIXED as listed. has_base_href scans every node (assets.rs:319-330); with any <base href> every relative reference is Denied(BaseHref) before the port (:348-350), and the base itself is reported (:402-410). attr_kind (:125-146) adds href/xlink:href on every element (svg image/use/a), frame src, formaction, background, poster, object data/codebase/classid/archive, ping, srcset/imagesrcset candidates, cite, longdesc/lowsrc/manifest, iframe srcdoc -> Denied(InlineDocument), and meta refresh whose http-equiv is compared after charref decoding (:486-490). DESCRIPTOR scanned/not_scanned is updated (lib.rs:34). Tests are at :750-781 and :784-831.

Numeric character references decode with or without ';' and with any digit count (charref.rs:67-85), matching the test at :717-747. A well-formed unknown &name; denies the value (Denied(UndecodableReference)) before the port (assets.rs:388-390). <style> RAWTEXT in HTML is correctly not charref-decoded (assets.rs:445).

R5 PLAUSIBLE relative-ref containment partly addressed: backslash and %2e/%2f/%5c in the path are Denied(AmbiguousPath) before the port (assets.rs:184-192, 351-353). Plain .. is documented as the port's containment duty (:29-35).

V4-06 count matches: the lane's class regex over src/ at bd8533f yields exactly 37 matches at the same 37 file:line sites the lane lists. The site 'charref.rs:60 decode_value definition = fixed' is inaccurate per finding 1.
lanes.recommendation_note: The listed R5 items are fixed and the CSS tokenizer is faithful to CSS Syntax 3. But the decode-before-classify contract still breaks in two places: legacy semicolon-less &quot in attributes, and over-decoding of style under HTML integration points. Both let an external url() reach a browser without being collected or denied.
